system.description:
This skill may only target a character with [Incapacitated]. The target removes their [Incapacitated] condition, and recovers [[/r @battle-status.power.magic.total+ @battle-status.power.restoration.total]]{[(Magic Power) + (Recovery)] HP.} 

(Hate 1): The target may reduce their [Hate] by -2.

Magic that revives life with magical power and gives the power to rise again to those who have fallen. Basic resurrection magic.
